items.title: I created an AI Assistant for language teachers
items.raw_excerpt:
I built an AI assistant for language teachers. It automates the repetitive parts of teaching a language: - Creating lesson plans.
- Creating and correcting homework and language learning activities (listening, writing, multiple choice, and soon adding speaking exercises!).
- Teachers get personalised feedback of the weaknesses and strengths of their students. The goal wasn’t to “replace” teachers but to shorten the feedback loop so learning happens faster. items.title: SQL with AI Operators on Text, Images, and Sound Files
items.raw_excerpt:
ThalamusDB is a semantic query processing engine that processes SQL queries with AI operators, e.g.: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Cars WHERE NLfilter(Cars.pic, 'this is a red car'); SELECT H.pic FROM HolidayPictures H, ProfilePictures P
WHERE P.name in ('Alice', 'Bob')
AND NLFILTER(H.pic, 'a picture of the beach')
AND NLJOIN(H.pic, P.pic, 'the same person appears in both pictures'); Simply store paths of image or sound files in your database tables, and ThalamusDB automatically selects the right language model to evaluate operators. You can set per-query thresholds on evaluation time or token consumption (i.e., money) as well. More info on the official website: https://itrummer.github.io/thalamusdb/

items.title: 万兴科技AIGC视频创作平台ToMoviee AI亮相日本2025秋季人工智能展会
items.raw_excerpt: 36氪获悉，近日，在日本NexTech Week 2025秋季人工智能展会上，万兴科技首次面向日本市场线下展示其全新AIGC视频创作平台ToMoviee AI，此次参展是ToMoviee AI产品在日本的首次线下亮相。据了解，该平台在文生视频大模型评测榜单VBench-2.0中综合得分位列全球前三，并在摄像机运动和运动合理性两项关键指标上获得第一。万兴科技自2011年进入日本市场，目前在当地拥有5600余家合作伙伴。

title_i18n.zh: 万兴科技AIGC视频创作平台ToMoviee AI亮相日本2025秋季人工智能展会
title_i18n.en: Wondershare's AIGC video creation platform, ToMoviee AI, debuted at the Japan 2025 Autumn Artificial Intelligence Exhibition.
title_i18n.es: La plataforma de creación de vídeos AIGC de Wanxing Technology, ToMoviee AI, se presenta en la Exposición de Inteligencia Artificial de Otoño de Japón 2025.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 36氪获悉，近日，在日本NexTech Week 2025秋季人工智能展会上，万兴科技首次面向日本市场线下展示其全新AIGC视频创作平台ToMoviee AI，此次参展是ToMoviee AI产品在日本的首次线下亮相。据了解，该平台在文生视频大模型评测榜单VBench-2.0中综合得分位列全球前三，并在摄像机运动和运动合理性两项关键指标上获得第一。万兴科技自2011年进入日本市场，目前在当地拥有5600余家合作伙伴。
excerpt_i18n.en: 36Kr learned that recently at Japan's NexTech Week 2025 Fall AI Exhibition, Wanxing Technology debuted its new AIGC video creation platform ToMoviee AI offline for the Japanese market, marking the product's first in-person showcase in Japan. The platform ranks among the top three globally in the VBench-2.0 text-to-video model evaluation rankings and leads in two key metrics: camera motion and motion reasonableness. Since entering the Japanese market in 2011, Wanxing Technology has established over 5,600 local partners.
excerpt_i18n.es: Según 36Kr, recientemente en la feria de inteligencia artificial NexTech Week 2025 de otoño en Japón, Wanxing Technology presentó por primera vez de forma presencial en el mercado japonés su nueva plataforma de creación de vídeos AIGC ToMoviee AI, marcando la primera aparición física del producto en Japón. Se conoce que la plataforma ocupa el tercer puesto mundial en la clasificación de evaluación de modelos de generación de vídeo VBench-2.0 y logró el primer lugar en dos indicadores clave: movimiento de cámara y racionalidad del movimiento. Wanxing Technology entró en el mercado japonés en 2011 y actualmente cuenta con más de 5.600 socios locales.

items.raw_excerpt: 刚刚过去的国庆，各行各业进入放假模式，但大模型行业却一刻也没闲着。 过去的半个月，国内外大模型的头部团队有十余款重磅产品发布，但每个团队的产品侧重不同。 其中，九月下旬，阿里发布以 Qwen3-Max 为代表的全家桶产品，大秀了一把肌肉；九月末，DeepSeek 和 Anthropic 瞄准真实编程场景，先后发布了 DeepSeek V3.2-Exp 和 Claude Sonnet 4.5，此外，智谱也拿出 GLM-4.6，目标冲击国内最强代码模型。 有人全盘布局，也有人专攻精尖，在大模型领域竞争驶向深水区后，各个公司战略路线出现了分野。 10 月 9 日凌晨，蚂蚁百灵大模型团队奇袭般官宣了一款自家最新语言大模型 Ling-1T，参数量达到 1000B（即 1万亿参数）。然而，就在十天前，百灵团队才将自研 Ring-1T-preview 大模型开源。 短短十天内，发布并开源两款万亿参数模型，如此密集的产品发布让蚂蚁百灵大模型成为了行业热议对象。 与此同时，这样毫无保留的开源动作，也让业界猜测：蚂蚁到底意图何在？ 01 探索智能上限是终极目标 据雷峰网了解，蚂蚁集团研发的基础大模型取名“百灵”，寓意“百试百灵”，也蕴含科技普惠之意，和阿里一样，蚂蚁也是独立团队独立研发，Ling-1T 和 Ring-1T-preview 分别是蚂蚁百灵团队研发的非思考模型和思考模型。 过去半年时间里，蚂蚁一直在对百灵大模型进行迭代优化，并且自上而下形成了三条技术探索路线： 一条是以 MoE 架构为基础的非思考模型 Ling-Series，另一条是思考模型 R

excerpt_i18n.en: During the recent National Day holiday, while various industries entered a break mode, the large model sector remained highly active. Over the past two weeks, more than ten major products were launched by leading teams globally, each with distinct focuses. In late September, Alibaba showcased its strength by releasing a full suite of products, represented by Qwen3-Max. At the end of September, DeepSeek and Anthropic targeted real-world programming scenarios, successively launching DeepSeek V3.2-Exp and Claude Sonnet 4.5, while Zhipu introduced GLM-4.6, aiming to become the top code model in China. Some companies pursued comprehensive strategies, while others specialized in cutting-edge areas, leading to divergent strategic paths as competition in the large model field intensified. On the early morning of October 9, Ant Group's Bailing large model team surprisingly announced its latest language model, Ling-1T, with a parameter count of 1000B (1 trillion parameters). However, just ten days prior, the Bailing team had open-sourced its self-developed Ring-1T-preview model. Releasing and open-sourcing two trillion-parameter models within such a short span made Ant Bailing's product launches exceptionally dense.
excerpt_i18n.es: Durante las recientes vacaciones nacionales, mientras diversos sectores entraban en modo de descanso, la industria de los grandes modelos no se detuvo ni un momento. En las últimas dos semanas, más de diez equipos líderes en grandes modelos, tanto nacionales como internacionales, lanzaron productos destacados, aunque cada equipo se centró en aspectos distintos. A finales de septiembre, Alibaba presentó su conjunto completo de productos, destacando Qwen3-Max para demostrar su fortaleza; a finales de mes, DeepSeek y Anthropic, enfocándose en escenarios de programación real, lanzaron sucesivamente DeepSeek V3.2-Exp y C.
